form.name: LOCAL_DOMAIN
form.label: This is the unique identifier of your server in the network. It cannot be safely changed later.

form.name: REDIS_HOST
form.label: Redis server hostname

form.name: REDIS_PORT
form.label: Redis port

form.name: DB_HOST
form.label: Postgres database hostname

form.name: DB_USER
form.label: Postgres username

form.name: DB_NAME
form.label: Postgres db name

form.name: DB_PASS
form.label: Postgres password

form.name: DB_PORT
form.label: Postgres port

form.name: ES_ENABLED
form.label: Enable or disable Elasticsearch (requires a separate ES instance)

form.name: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_PRIMARY_KEY
form.label: Primary key for Active Record Encryption.

form.name: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_DETERMINISTIC_KEY
form.label: Deterministic key for Active Record Encryption.

form.name: ACTIVE_RECORD_ENCRYPTION_KEY_DERIVATION_SALT
form.label: Derivation salt for Active Record Encryption.

form.name: SECRET_KEY_BASE
form.label: Browser session secret. Changing it will break all active browser sessions.

form.name: OTP_SECRET
form.label: MFA secret. Changing it after initial setup will break two-factor authentication.

form.name: VAPID_PRIVATE_KEY
form.label: Push notification private key. Changing it after initial setup will break push notifications.

form.name: VAPID_PUBLIC_KEY
form.label: Push notification public key. Changing it after initial setup will break push notifications.

form.name: SMTP_SERVER
form.label: SMTP server for email notifications

form.name: SMTP_PORT
form.label: SMTP server port

form.name: SMTP_LOGIN
form.label: SMTP username

form.name: SMTP_PASSWORD
form.label: SMTP password

form.name: SMTP_FROM_ADDRESS
form.label: From address for emails send from Mastodon

form.name: S3_ENABLED
form.label: Enable or disable S3 storage of uploaded files

form.name: WEB_DOMAIN
form.label: This can be set if you want your server identifier to be different to the subdomain hosting Mastodon. See https://docs.joinmastodon.org/admin/config/#basic

form.name: ES_HOST
form.label: Elasticsearch server hostname

form.name: ES_PORT
form.label: Elasticsearch port

form.name: ES_USER
form.label: Elasticsearch username

form.name: ES_PASS
form.label: Elasticsearch password

form.name: S3_BUCKET
form.label: S3 bucket hostname

form.name: AWS_ACCESS_KEY_ID
form.label: S3 bucket access key ID

form.name: AWS_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY
form.label: S3 bucket secret access key

form.name: S3_ALIAS_HOST
form.label: Alternate hostname for object fetching if you are front the S3 connections.

form.name: SIDEKIQ_ONLY
form.label: Only run the sidekiq service in this container instance. For large scale instances that need better queue handling.

form.name: SIDEKIQ_QUEUE
form.label: The name of the sidekiq queue to run in this container. See notes.

form.name: SIDEKIQ_DEFAULT
form.label: Set to true on the main container if you're running additional sidekiq instances. It will run the default queue.

form.name: SIDEKIQ_THREADS
form.label: The number of threads for sidekiq to use. See notes.

form.name: DB_POOL
form.label: The size of the DB connection pool, must be at least the same as SIDEKIQTHREADS. See notes.

form.name: NO_CHOWN
form.label: Set to true to skip chown of /config on init. READ THE APPLICATION NOTES BEFORE SETTING THIS.

form.name: MASTODON_PROMETHEUS_EXPORTER_ENABLED
form.label: If set to true, Mastodon’s Ruby processes (web & Sidekiq) will enable the Prometheus instrumentation.
